title: Offline Lab Per-Arch Package Index
description: packages/<arch>/index.json — one entry per package (latest version only). Signed with the repo's index key. Devices download only the index for their arch. Each entry points at a DDI (.raw) and its metadata JSON; both must resolve to the same origin as the repo base_url (same-server rule). See docs/specs/repository.md.

spec_version.description: Schema version. Always '1' for this version of the spec.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.

key_rotation.description: Incremented on each option B key rotation. appctl re-verifies all installed packages from this repo when the counter increases.

packages.description: One entry per package name. Latest published version only. Version history is a client-side concern.

tags.description: Classification tags. Used for appctl search.

runtime.description: Runtime mode. Mirrors package.yaml so appctl search can display it without downloading metadata. Defaults to 'portable' when omitted.

ddi_size.description: Size of the DDI .raw file in bytes. Used for the pre-install storage check.

ddi_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the DDI .raw file, lowercase hex.

signing_key_id.description: SHA-256 fingerprint (hex) of the build key that signed this package's DDI signature partition. appctl looks up the matching cert under /etc/verity.d/ to verify at install time.

custom_profile.description: True if the package uses systemd_profile: custom. Flagged in appctl list output.

raw_url.description: Relative URL to the DDI .raw file (<name>_<version>_<arch>.raw). Relative to repo base_url; must resolve to the same origin (same-server rule).

metadata_url.description: Relative URL to the package metadata JSON file. Relative to repo base_url; must resolve to the same origin (same-server rule).

zip_url.description: Optional relative URL to a transport zip bundling the DDI .raw and metadata .json. Relative to repo base_url. raw_url + metadata_url are the canonical references.
